title: Chemistry and properties of fluorescent pyrazole derivatives: an approach to bioimaging applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39230-39241
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07485H, Review Article
Open Access

Santiago Melo-Hernández, María-Camila Ríos, Jaime Portilla
This review considers the latest advancements (2020 to 2024, five articles per year) in the development of fluorescent probes, focusing on the synthesis, chemistry, and properties of pyrazole derivatives for bioimaging applications.
